title: The AI feature you don't need is why your site is slow.
styleLine: Kymbo scene photography — see profiles/kymbo/build/prompts/VISUAL.md. World: same Kymbo software-studio as scene-21 but STILLER and QUIETER — this scene is about restraint. Closed laptops preferred, analog objects preferred, deliberately un-tech-flashy. Walls off-white plaster (#EDEAE4) or unpainted concrete. Floor dark polished concrete or dark oak. Walnut desks with visible wear. Palette: near-black cool shadows (#0A0D14), cool near-white highlights (#F1F3F6). Metal is brushed steel or matte black. Objects read as SOMEONE WHO SAYS NO WORKS HERE — a lamp turned OFF, a closed notebook, an empty mug, a mechanical toggle in the DOWN position. Documentary, unposed — Apartamento / The Gentlewoman feel, not resort brochure. 35mm color negative, ONE dominant side-window key at ~5pm late afternoon (long slanted light), clear light side, deep near-black shadow side. Composition: off-center, asymmetric weight, one object cropped by the frame edge. UNIVERSALLY PROHIBITED: succulents, round white ceramic pots, fiddle-leaf figs, monstera, jute rugs, terrazzo, perfectly stacked photogenic books, fresh flowers in glass, Apple tastemaker signals, motivational wall art, neon signs, pastel walls, symmetric three-object triangles, centered composition, soft even daylight, blown-out windows, 'AI robot' or 'AI icon' props (nothing that looks like AI at all — this is the OPPOSITE piece), digital LEDs, glowing screens, 'productivity workspace' clichés. 4:5 native (1080x1350), do NOT letterbox / pad / extend / outpaint. Fill the ENTIRE 4:5 frame with natural scene content — CSS overlay handles text; NO dark band or vignette. No visible text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B. All six pure editorial photos — no composites. The restraint is the point.

slides.imagePrompt: A walnut desk in the ~5pm late-afternoon side-window slice, deliberately STILL. Center-left of frame: a closed matte-black laptop with a small scratch on the lid, a paper notebook closed on top of it, an old-style brass-and-black desk lamp turned OFF beside them. Right-third breathes: a chipped ceramic mug at the edge, coffee at 1/3 level (running low, unfinished). Foreground: coffee rings and a small ink stain on the desk. Background: off-white plaster wall, unadorned. Hard side-window key from left, deep shadow side on the right face of the lamp. PROHIBITED IN THIS FRAME: no succulents, no plants of any kind, no round white pots, no jute rug, no pastel wall, no motivational quote, no AI-robot prop, no glowing screen — this is the OPPOSITE of AI-flashy. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.headline: The AI feature you don't need is why your site is ==slow==.
slides.sub: Every "AI Assistant" script is 300KB of JavaScript and one more thing that can break.

slides.imagePrompt: A hand near a small mechanical toggle switch on a walnut desk (an analog audio-toggle style switch — brushed steel body, matte black switch head). The switch is in the DOWN/OFF position. Hand from wrist down only, index finger has just left the switch. Background out of focus: a closed matte-black laptop, a chipped ceramic mug. Foreground: coffee ring visible on the desk near the switch. Hard side-window key from left — the switch head catches a small specular highlight on its top curve. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no plants, no round white pots, no pastel wall, no digital screen or LED anywhere in the frame — this is analog, mechanical, OFF. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.title: Turn every AI feature ==off== for a week.
slides.body: Measure your bounce rate before and after. If nothing changes, the feature was scenery. If bounce goes up, we can talk about the right AI to put back.

slides.imagePrompt: A walnut chair pulled up to a desk, cool late-afternoon side-window light coming from behind the chair (backlight). The chair is empty. On the desk (foreground): a chipped ceramic mug half-full of coffee, a closed notebook, a coffee ring near the mug. LEFT of the chair, in soft focus: a MATURE LEMON TREE or an OLIVE TREE in a terracotta planter (NOT a succulent, NOT a fiddle-leaf, NOT in a round white pot) — the plant is real, established, tall. Hard side-window key from behind — chair silhouette rim-lit, desk in half-shadow. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no small houseplants, no round white pots, no jute rug, no pastel wall, no motivational sign, no perfect symmetric layout. [STYLE LINE applies.]
slides.headline: We put AI in when it ==earns== its weight.
slides.sub: Not when the client saw a demo.
